pos.personaBrief: Sources say he wants teams to take the game on and not wait (ge), Vasco had 51% vs Fluminense and wanted to control with the ball against Coritiba, yet his wins came on counters with fast wide players (Lance!, VAVEL).

pro.personaBrief: He builds short from the back with a three-man exit and a volante dropping (ge, Lance!), values clean ball from Tche Tche, and attacks quickly on transitions and with crosses at Al Taawoun.

est.personaBrief: Well-defined phases (construcao a tres, 4-2-3-1 to 4-1-4-1, Sosa controlling distance between lines), with some fluid roles such as Colidio dropping as a meia and wingers shifted centrally.

lar.personaBrief: Al Taawoun was third in crosses with bold wingers and daring full-backs, and Vasco uses fast wide players and full-backs jumping the line, though with a three-volante midfield.

blo.personaBrief: Presses in three moments, a medium/high 4-1-4-1, intense pressing at Al Taawoun and aggressive regains, dropping to 4-4-1 or a five-man line only when protecting a lead.

mar.personaBrief: Only VAVEL mentions individual encaixes against Fluminense, while his structure otherwise relies on compact lines and positioning; evidence is thin and mixed.

pla.personaBrief: He says he makes a plan for each opponent and picks players accordingly, changed the Vitoria game with substitutions, and shifted shape between games (two vs three volantes), while keeping a base build-up.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic knockout winner: closed games with five defenders at the end vs Fluminense, three volantes for defensive consistency, praise for clean sheets; cup titles over aesthetics.

sis.personaBrief: Collective tactical roles and duties for all, rotating players by performance, competitive squad; a system with discipline (Sosa, balanco defensivo) over individual freedom.

jog.personaBrief: Wants intensity in duels and marking (three volantes, Rojas cobrado for intensity), Taawoun with most fouls, but also values quality on the ball and passing from the midfield.

bas.personaBrief: Says quality has no age and played two 17-year-olds, calls up a base player at Vasco, but also signs foreigners and keeps competition; neither strongly youth nor experience.

lid.personaBrief: Resets the group, builds confidence and tells players they are always valuable, but says no places are guaranteed and leaves players out by choice.
